questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right ahead. You should slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be careful when wet roads make driving slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. Give the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or roadway you are entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing.

Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for highway exits. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive with extra care in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the curve goes to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spots reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is ahead. Enter at low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

options.text: You must turn left or right.

The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When you extend your left arm straight out to the left, you are signaling that you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and increase your following distance from other vehicles.
